name: nexus-social-aggregator
description: NEXUS - Social Media Aggregator Platform (unified feed + cross-posting for Twitter, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @nexus/api" "npm run dev -w @nexus/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexus/api && npm run build -w @nexus/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @nexus/api && npm run lint -w @nexus/web
